description: Two sine oscillators passed through a Peter de Jong equation used as a wave shaper, which folds them into two related waveforms.

params.text: How much the FQ1 jack moves the first sine's pitch. With nothing patched into FQ1 this knob is a fine tune instead.
How much the FQ2 jack moves the second sine's pitch. With nothing patched into FQ2 this knob is a fine tune instead.
The first of the four constants in the de Jong equations.
The second of the four constants in the de Jong equations.
The third of the four constants in the de Jong equations.
The fourth of the four constants in the de Jong equations.
Sets the frequency range both sines cover: up is the audio range, middle is a clock range, down is a slow modulation range.

inputs.text: Moves the first sine's pitch, by as much as the MOD knob beside the first FQ allows.
Moves the second sine's pitch, by as much as the MOD knob beside the second FQ allows.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the MOD knob acts as a fine tune.
